rows.title: Quiet hours across midnight
rows.defect: the end hour itself still counts as quiet
rows.test: 7:30 a.m. is no longer quiet

rows.title: The person's own clock
rows.defect: the UTC hour is used as the person's hour
rows.test: 03:00 UTC is 8 p.m. in Los Angeles

rows.title: A fee alert is for a fee
rows.defect: the fee rule matches letters inside words, so ATM cash is a fee (the bug found building the LEDGER packet)
rows.test: an ATM withdrawal fires no fee alert

rows.title: Safety at once, the rest in the morning
rows.defect: safety is held with everything else
rows.test: a fraud shape at 11 p.m. goes out now

rows.title: Watches come through quiet hours
rows.defect: a watch is held like any finding (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a balance watch at 11 p.m. is delivered

rows.title: Held until 7 a.m. local
rows.defect: the end hour is taken as UTC
rows.test: held until 11:00 UTC in New York

rows.title: Watches are never bundled
rows.defect: a watch is folded into the bundle
rows.test: a watch stays its own message beside a bundle

rows.title: Two are said one by one
rows.defect: two items make a bundle
rows.test: two ordinary items are not bundled

rows.title: The exact number
rows.defect: the thousands comma is not removed

rows.title: Refused, never guessed
rows.defect: 'go below' is read as a balance falling
rows.test: 'gas prices go below $3' is not a balance watch

rows.title: Available, not the books
rows.defect: the watch compares the ledger balance
rows.test: $600 with $400 available is below $500

rows.title: The last 3 days, from the watch's own day
rows.defect: every charge in the rows is read
rows.test: a charge from before the watch was set does not fire; one 5 days old does not either

rows.title: Usual needs five past charges
rows.defect: one past charge sets the usual
rows.test: two $15 dinners do not make $60 large

rows.title: Three first-time merchants is safety
rows.defect: four are needed
rows.test: three new shops in a day go out as safety

rows.title: The person's buffer
rows.defect: the default $100 buffer is always used
rows.test: under a $500 buffer on Oct 15

rows.title: One thing means one charge, nothing more (megadoc L09)
rows.defect: the end anchor is dropped, so a merchant after 'one thing' is ignored and a charge-over watch is guessed
rows.test: 'spend over 100 on one thing at target' is refused

rows.title: No merchant, no refund watch
rows.defect: a refund with no merchant is watched with an empty merchant, matching every credit
rows.test: 'tell me when refund posts' is not a refund watch

rows.title: The merchant as typed
rows.defect: the merchant is kept lower-cased and title-cased, so REI becomes Rei
rows.test: REI stays REI

rows.title: Business days skip weekends
rows.defect: business days are counted as calendar days
rows.test: 7 business days from Mon Oct 12 is Wed Oct 21

rows.title: No impossible date
rows.defect: Feb 30 rolls over to Mar 2
rows.test: Feb 30 is no deadline

rows.title: The refund to the cent
rows.defect: any credit from the merchant is taken as the refund
rows.test: a $45.99 credit is the $45.99 refund

rows.title: Another credit is said, not swallowed
rows.defect: other credits from the merchant are ignored
rows.test: a $12.00 credit is said with the watch still on

rows.title: Late is the day after
rows.defect: the deadline day itself is called late
rows.test: on the deadline day nothing is late

rows.title: Pending is not posted
rows.defect: a pending credit is said as posted
rows.test: a pending $45.99 credit is not the refund

rows.title: No apostrophe still a refund watch
rows.defect: the negation is kept in the merchant ("airbnb doesnt")
rows.test: 'refund from airbnb doesnt show up' is merchant airbnb

rows.title: The payer as subject
rows.defect: only 'my X refund' is read
rows.test: 'amazon hasnt refunded me' is a refund watch

rows.title: By the 20th
rows.defect: a passed day of the month is this month's
rows.test: 'by the 5th' after the 5th is next month's

rows.title: A generic payer is not a merchant
rows.defect: "airline" is taken as the merchant
rows.test: 'my refund from the airline' sets nothing

rows.title: A re-fire updates the last reported low
rows.defect: a re-fire does not update the episode's report count, so the next comparison is against a stale low
rows.test: the second report is counted and becomes the comparison point

rows.title: Seven days sooner is material
rows.defect: the date leg needs a month, so a dip arriving a week sooner is never said
rows.test: a first day 8 days closer re-fires; 6 days does not
